s1.title: Choose your dates
s1.body: Tell us when you arrive and how many guests are travelling. No account and no payment needed to start.

s2.title: Pick your room
s2.body: Browse Nile-view and garden rooms, add a sunset felucca or a temple visit, and send your request in a minute.

s3.title: Confirm on WhatsApp
s3.body: Our reception reviews your request and confirms it directly on WhatsApp, with your reference number and arrival details.

r1.text: We woke up to the Nile every morning. The room was quiet, spotless, and exactly as pictured.

r2.text: Booking was effortless. We sent a request and had a confirmation on WhatsApp within the hour.

r3.text: The felucca at sunset was the highlight of our trip, and the hotel arranged everything for us.
